answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before it can earn, and bind each epoch's attestation proof to that one live key. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but each copy needs its own locked bond and its own proof, so the cost scales with every fake. Like a raven returning each night to the same sable perch, an identity that cannot whisper the same secret twice is exposed: duplicates get slashed, while one honest agent keeps one bond and keeps earning.
